auth.explainer.body1: An end-to-end encrypted messenger that runs only on this device. The server sees ciphertext only — never plaintext.
auth.explainer.body2: Heads up: there is no backup, no recovery, no password reset. If you lose the device or wipe the browser, your messages and handle are gone for good. To move to another device you have to run the transfer flow from this one.
auth.restore.label: saved session
auth.form.handle.hint: lowercase, digits, _ only. Cannot be changed once set.
auth.wipe: wipe all keys and cache from this browser
newChat.title: new direct chat
newChat.sub: Enter the peer handle. They have to be registered on the same server.
msg.empty.title: no messages yet
msg.empty.sub: use the input below to send the first one
msg.input.placeholder: Message (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline)
msg.confirmDelete.title: delete message
msg.confirmDelete.body: This message will be deleted. The recipient will also see a deleted-marker.
auth.restore.rejected: The server rejected this device's session — the device may have been revoked. Your keys are still on this browser.
keyChange.banner: @{handle}'s security key changed. Sending in this chat is paused until you review it.
keyChange.confirmBody: They may have switched devices, or someone may be trying to intercept this conversation. Only accept after confirming with them another way (in person, a call).
keyChange.sendBlocked: This contact's security key changed. Review it at the top of the chat before sending.
keyChange.composerFrozen: Sending paused until the key change is reviewed
storage.upgradeBlocked: Close VEIL in your other tabs to continue: an older version is still open there.
storage.wipeBlocked: Close VEIL in your other tabs to finish deleting: an older version there is keeping the data open.
peer.notUpgraded: This contact's app is too old for end-to-end encrypted sessions. Ask them to update.
peer.unavailable: Could not start an encrypted session with this contact.
keyChange.bannerVerified: @{handle}'s security key changed. You had verified them: compare the new safety number before sending again.
keyChange.bannerUnverifiedDevice: @{handle} is using a device you have not verified. You had verified them: compare this device's safety number before sending again.
keyChange.superseded: @{handle}'s key changed again while you were reviewing it. Review the new one.
keyChange.declineBody: Messages from it stay locked and you will not be asked about it again. This chat goes on sending to the key you already have for @{handle}. If they really use this device, its messages will stay unreadable here.
keyChange.declineSessionKey: This chat sends to that key, so it cannot be declined. Compare safety numbers with @{handle} instead.
keyChange.sendRefused: The key this chat would send to is one you declined, or a device of another contact. Nothing was sent.
safety.unverifiedDevice: This device was accepted before you verified @{handle}, but never verified. Only mark it verified after comparing this number with them.
group.composerFrozen: The web demo cannot send end-to-end encrypted group messages
safety.title: Safety number with @{handle}
safety.pendingKey: This is a new key that has not been accepted yet. Only verify it after comparing it with them.
safety.explain: Compare these numbers with @{handle} in person or over a call. If they match, nobody is in the middle.
safety.pastePlaceholder: Paste the code from their screen
safety.mismatch: The codes do not match. Do not trust this key.
safety.noKey: No key pinned for @{handle} yet: exchange a message first.
safety.notSignedIn: This device has not signed in yet. Sign in once, then compare safety numbers.
legacy.badge: legacy, not forward-secret, sender not authenticated
legacy.composerFrozen: This identity uses the old demo format and cannot send
legacy.banner: This browser's identity uses the old demo format. You can read its history but not send. Create a new identity to keep messaging.
history.deleteBody: This device's copy of the conversation is destroyed for good, and messages the server still relays stay unreadable here. The other side keeps theirs.
report.title: Report @{handle}
report.explain: Only the reason you pick and the IDs of this message and conversation are sent. The message's content stays on this device.
